goal: Collect the latest 200 public LinkedIn posts from Adam Robinson at https://www.linkedin.com/in/retentionadam using scraper.linkedin_profile_posts exclusively with pagination, preserving text, author, dates, URLs, and all metadata.

routes.label: Source-specific scrape
routes.description: Use a specialized adapter for a known source such as LinkedIn posts or source-specific web data.
preflight: Use source-specific adapters only when the target source is explicit.
Confirm the URL pattern and row scope before live execution.
Avoid public side effects; scraping is read-only but may still consume credits.

operating_rules: Plan first, inspect the selected tool descriptor, then run a bounded dry-run or one-page pilot.
Use live execution only with explicit max_credits and page/row caps.
Write provider output into a workspace table and inspect run/provenance before enrichment or outbound.
Use known-URL scrape routes when URLs are already known; use web search only to discover unknown URLs.

metadata.authored_selection: Native scraper explicitly selected from live descriptor; generated plan suggested unrequested providers which were not executed.
